name: Aerial Shot
description: 지리·도시 규모와 이동 경로를 함께 보여줍니다.
instruction: Frame the location from an oblique elevated viewpoint. Keep a recognizable scale anchor and the route through foreground, middle ground and distance legible.

name: Birds Eye View
description: 상공 수직 시점으로 공간 배치를 보여줍니다.
instruction: Look vertically down from above with no horizon. Keep the spatial arrangement and subject positions readable.

name: Close Up
description: 표정과 시선을 가까이 읽습니다.
instruction: Frame the face closely with natural perspective, clear eyeline and enough margin for the specified expression.

name: Dutch Angle
description: 불안정함이 필요한 장면에 고정된 기울기를 사용합니다.
instruction: Use a modest fixed roll angle with a readable horizon or vertical reference. Keep the angle constant during the action.

name: Dolly Shot
description: 실제 카메라 이동으로 거리와 시차를 바꿉니다.
instruction: Move the camera slowly along one short straight path while maintaining the subject's screen position; settle at the stated ending composition.

name: Establishing Shot
description: 장면의 장소·출입구·동선을 먼저 설명합니다.
instruction: Use a wide location view that shows the principal subject, access points and spatial relationships needed to understand the action.

name: Extreme Close Up
description: 사건을 결정하는 작은 디테일 하나에 집중합니다.
instruction: Isolate one specified small detail in extreme close-up. Keep its position and physical state legible without exaggerated surface detail.

name: Extreme Long Shot
description: 작은 피사체와 넓은 환경의 크기를 비교합니다.
instruction: Place a small but identifiable subject within a vast environment with readable scale references at multiple distances.

name: Eye Level Shot
description: 인물 눈높이에서 중립적으로 관찰합니다.
instruction: Position the camera at the subject's eye height with a level horizon and natural perspective.

name: Handheld Shot
description: 현장에서 관찰자가 따라가는 호흡을 만듭니다.
instruction: Use restrained handheld breathing drift at a consistent distance, responding to the subject's movement. Avoid random shake; settle on the final state.

name: Head On Shot
description: 카메라를 향한 시선·접근을 보여줍니다.
instruction: Frame the subject approaching or facing the lens directly, maintaining readable space around the subject.

name: High Angle Shot
description: 위에서 인물과 주변 압박·출구를 함께 읽습니다.
instruction: Look diagonally down from above the subject, keeping surrounding barriers and exits legible with moderate perspective.

name: Insert Shot
description: 손·소품·작동의 중요한 정보를 보여줍니다.
instruction: Frame the specified hand or scene-owned object tightly enough to read the action. Preserve its owner, orientation and surrounding spatial cues.

name: Long Shot
description: 전신 동작과 주변 거리를 동시에 보여줍니다.
instruction: Keep the entire subject from head to feet visible with room for the action and readable distance to nearby objects.

name: Low Angle Shot
description: 아래에서 올려다보며 수직 관계를 강조합니다.
instruction: Place the camera moderately below the subject and look upward, preserving recognizable proportions and vertical scale cues.

name: Master Shot
description: 전체 행동과 인물 간 위치를 유지합니다.
instruction: Frame the complete action area with readable actor spacing, entrances and eyelines throughout this shot.

name: Medium Shot
description: 표정·손·몸짓을 균형 있게 담습니다.
instruction: Use waist-up framing with space for hands and gestures, natural perspective and readable nearby context.

name: Over The Shoulder
description: 상대와의 거리·시선 관계를 보여줍니다.
instruction: Frame the speaking or reacting subject past the other person's foreground shoulder, preserving the established eyeline and screen direction.

name: Overhead Shot
description: 손의 작업과 물건 배치를 수직으로 보여줍니다.
instruction: Look vertically down at the working surface. Keep the hands, object arrangement and procedural paths fully visible.

name: Pan Shot
description: 고정 위치에서 좌우로 주의를 옮깁니다.
instruction: Rotate horizontally from the stated opening target toward the ending target at a measured speed, without translating the camera. Stop and hold the final framing.

name: Pov Shot
description: 누가 무엇을 보는지 명확히 합니다.
instruction: Use the named observer's eye position and height to show the stated target; keep the owner's viewing direction consistent.

name: Rack Focus
description: 두 거리의 대상 사이로 주의를 옮깁니다.
instruction: Keep the camera position fixed and shift focus once from the specified near target to the specified far target after the action cue; hold the destination in focus.

name: Slow Motion
description: 빠른 사건의 정점을 천천히 읽습니다.
instruction: Show the stated action in continuous slow motion with a stable camera and physically consistent direction and contact; resolve on the final state.

name: Steadicam
description: 매끄럽게 이동하며 공간을 연결합니다.
instruction: Follow the subject smoothly along the stated route at a consistent distance and height, using gentle acceleration and a level horizon; settle at the destination.

name: Tracking Shot
description: 움직이는 피사체와 함께 실제로 이동합니다.
instruction: Track alongside the moving subject at a matching speed, consistent height and medium travel distance. Preserve foreground parallax and settle when the subject stops.

name: Vertigo Effect
description: 거리 이동과 줌을 반대로 결합해 공간감을 바꿉니다.
instruction: Make one short, slow dolly move paired with an opposing zoom so the subject size stays stable while the background perspective changes; stop together on the final beat.

name: Crane Shot
description: 높이 변화로 주변 관계를 순차 공개합니다.
instruction: Raise the camera smoothly over a moderate vertical distance from the subject toward the surrounding environment, keeping the original subject traceable and ending on the wider context.

name: One Er
description: 연속 경로의 행동을 한 번에 유지합니다.
instruction: Follow the stated path in one uninterrupted take with measured speed and consistent eyelines; preserve every declared action boundary and finish at the specified endpoint.

name: Tilt Shot
description: 위아래로 연결된 정보를 공개합니다.
instruction: Rotate vertically from the stated opening detail to the ending target at a measured speed, without translating the camera; hold on the final target.

name: Whip Pan
description: 짧은 수평 회전 뒤 새 대상에 도착합니다.
instruction: Make one short fast horizontal pan after the cue, with brief directional blur, then stop on the stated destination and recover a clear stable frame.

name: Two Shot
description: 두 사람 사이 거리와 반응을 함께 읽습니다.
instruction: Frame both named people together, preserving their separation, body directions, eyelines and the space between them.

name: Three Shot
description: 세 사람의 위치·시선 관계를 보여줍니다.
instruction: Frame all three named people with distinct depth positions and readable eyelines, keeping their relative spacing clear.

name: Cowboy Shot
description: 표정과 허리 주변 손동작을 함께 보여줍니다.
instruction: Frame from mid-thigh to above the head so the face, hands and waist-level action remain visible throughout.

name: Medium Close Up
description: 대사와 어깨·호흡 반응을 읽습니다.
instruction: Use chest-up framing with a stable face scale, clear mouth and eyeline, preserving small shoulder and breathing changes.

name: Choker Shot
description: 표정 극점에 제한된 얼굴 영역을 보여줍니다.
instruction: Crop tightly from forehead to chin with natural facial perspective, maintaining the same face scale and eyeline.

name: Push In
description: 깨달음·결정에 맞춰 거리를 줄입니다.
instruction: Move physically toward the subject slowly over a short distance, reducing the framing by one shot size with visible parallax; end on a stable closer composition.

name: Pull Out
description: 주변 맥락을 드러내며 물러납니다.
instruction: Move physically backward slowly over a moderate distance, keeping the original subject visible while revealing the stated surroundings; end on a stable wider composition.

name: 360 Degree Shot
description: 동일 반경의 회전으로 피사체 주변을 보여줍니다.
instruction: Orbit the subject once at a slow even speed, fixed radius and height. Keep the subject size stable and return to the opening angle.

name: Static Shot
description: 카메라를 고정해 장면 안의 변화에 집중합니다.
instruction: Lock the camera position, angle and focal length for the entire shot; zero travel and zero zoom. Let the specified action change within the frame.

name: Crash Zoom
description: 빠른 렌즈 변화로 특정 대상에 집중합니다.
instruction: Keep the camera position fixed and make one short fast optical zoom to the specified detail; stop and hold the target clearly.

name: Worms Eye View
description: 지면 가까이에서 거대한 수직 구조를 보여줍니다.
instruction: Place the camera close to ground level looking steeply upward. Retain a ground reference and readable vertical structure while controlling distortion.
